title: Non-compliance with Central Authority direction
description: Failure to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21

content.offence: Whoever fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both

aliases: failing to comply with central authority
